intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文反差线记忆：Frinley 据说有一棵 cursed tree，报纸提到后游客增加；树很早就在 church 附近，但近几年才有 evil reputation；村民想让 vicar 砍树，vicar 却说它是 source of income；最后游客无视传说，到目前为止没人 sudden death。读的时候注意 reported rumor、present perfect 和 So far 的停顿。

sentences.text: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Frinley 这个小村据说有一棵 cursed tree。The tiny village of Frinley 是主语，is said to possess 要读成“据说拥有”。

sentences.text: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper, the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：因为报纸提到了这棵树，来 Frinley 的游客数量增加了。Because 引出原因，the number of visitors 是结果主语，has now increased 读出现时结果。

sentences.text: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago, but it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：这棵树 50 年前种在 church 附近，但只是近几年才有了 evil reputation。But 后面读出时间反差，has gained an evil reputation 是现在形成的名声。

sentences.text: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：据说摸树会倒霉，摘叶会死。It is said that 是传闻开头，不是证据；两个 if 分句要分组读。

sentences.text: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far he has refused.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：人们请求 vicar 让人把树砍掉，但到目前为止他拒绝了。Has been asked 是被请求，have the tree cut down 是安排别人砍树，so far he has refused 要读出“到现在还没有”。

sentences.text: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income, as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他指出这棵树是有用的收入来源，因为游客从全国各地来看它。Source of income 是核心短语，have been coming 读出游客一直在来。
focus_words: from all parts of the country

sentences.text: In spite of all that has been said, the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：尽管有这些说法，游客还是摘叶子、在树干上刻名字。In spite of 先读出让步，have been picking 和 cutting 表示一直反复发生的行为。

sentences.text: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：到目前为止，还没有一个人突然死去。So far 后短停，not one 要重读，has been struck down 是结尾的讽刺效果。
